scope: Only the fixed 49 existing manuscript-1106 full-floor modules in FUTURE_FULL_FLOOR_CONTINUATION.json. No new Lean proof, declaration, algorithm, hypothesis, runner, verifier or wider dependency traversal.

manifest_policy.no_source_missing_claim: No remote source presence was queried; the existence of a new manifest does not assert that its source is missing remotely.

execution_policy.unknown_or_unaccepted_dependencies: HOLD until exact existing owner/source/context evidence is identified and the stock no-build readiness gate succeeds. An import or object alone is not a complete owner acceptance.
execution_policy.complete_owner_acceptance_requires: Exact-source normal pass, independent kernel pass, full environment owned declaration/types/axioms audit and unchanged required source/object context.

historical_objects_without_complete_owne.policy: PRESERVE_EXISTING_OBJECTS; inspect exact existing evidence and the stock no-build gate; never delete or force rebuild to manufacture acceptance.
